name: cold14-twin
title: Twin jp8 words: st2u4's jp8 (u4) on 71 calls and st2's jp8 as a second provider jp8b on one call, with an exact per-time-Hall owner map (exact-window MIP warm-started from st2u4's map)
summary: Provider menu {jp8 (st2u4's u4 chain), jp8b (st2's jp8 chain)}; ck dropped. The global controls need two dispatched providers; st2u4 used ck on one call, twin uses st2's jp8 word there instead, which the aggregate LP prices lower (pinned at time 5: LP bound 523258.896187 with jp8b vs 523259.058061 with ck; BrainAdversary twinlp.py). Owner search (BrainAdversary twinmip.py mipA) with H4aFinish's solve_h.py (objective sum F(r) = r*(73/r)^b, b = 0.001636): exact-window MIP at dispatch jp8 x71, jp8b x1 (time 5) over base + st2u4's aggregate-LP patterns with weight >= 0.01, warm-started from st2u4's map, gap 1e-9, 1 thread, 900 s; the solver stdout was lost, so its status/gap line was not recorded (the 900 s limit was reached). mkplan.py --locals (jp8 = st2u4's jp8 local, jp8b = st2's jp8 local) reproduces data/PLAN.json byte for byte. The map is admitted by the package's verifier chain, not by the search.
